title: An Empirical Analysis of Static Analysis Methods for Detection and Mitigation of Code Library Hallucinations
abstract: arXiv:2604.07755v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite extensive research, Large Language Models continue to hallucinate when generating code, particularly when using libraries. On NL-to-code benchmarks that require library use, we find that LLMs generate code that uses non-existent library features in 8.1-40% of responses. One intuitive approach for detection and mitigation of hallucinations is static analysis. In this paper, we analyse the potential of static analysis tools, both in terms of what they can solve and what they cannot. We find that static analysis tools can detect 16-70% of all errors, and 14-85% of library hallucinations, with performance varying by LLM and dataset. Through manual analysis, we identify cases a static method could not plausibly catch, which gives an upper bound on their potential from 48.5% to 77%. translated_title: 用于检测和缓解代码库幻觉的静态分析方法的实证分析
translated_abstract: 尽管经过了大量研究，大型语言模型在生成代码时仍然会产生幻觉，尤其是在使用库的情况下。在需要使用库的自然语言到代码基准测试中，我们发现大语言模型在8.1%至40%的响应中生成了使用不存在的库功能的代码。检测和缓解幻觉的一种直观方法是静态分析。在本文中，我们分析了静态分析工具的潜力，包括它们能够解决什么问题以及无法解决什么问题。我们发现，静态分析工具可以检测出16%至70%的所有错误，以及14%至85%的库幻觉，其性能因大语言模型和数据集的不同而有所差异。通过人工分析，我们识别出了静态方法在合理情况下无法捕获的情形，这为其潜力给出了48.5%至77%的上限。总体而言，我们表明静态分析方法是解决某些形式幻觉的一种低成本手段，并且我们量化了它距离完全解决该问题还有多大差距。
tldr: 本文通过实证分析发现，静态分析工具能检测大语言模型14%至85%的代码库幻觉（理论上限为48.5%至77%），是缓解代码幻觉的低成本方案但无法彻底解决问题。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically shows that static analysis tools can detect 14–85% of LLM code library hallucinations (with a theoretical upper bound of 48.5–77%), making them a cheap but incomplete approach to mitigating code hallucinations.
